profile.headline: Software Engineer @Beast Code | JavaScript Specialist | React | Ruby on Rails
profile.summary: Full stack developer with an extensive 13-year background in education, resulting in strong leadership skills. Able to manage multiple concurrent projects, work on both ends of the development stack and adapt quickly to new technologies. Eager to learn and grow.

positions.title: Freelance Software Developer
positions.description:
- Update, modify, and expand existing software programs.
- Prepare original and relevant options for clients suitable to individual requirements.
- Provide quality assurance testing for pre-release software through continuous release development process.
- Plan website development, converting mockups into usable web presence with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Ruby on Rails.

positions.title: Ruby on Rails Developer
positions.description:
- Wrote clean, maintainable and efficient code
- Integration of user-facing elements with server-side logic
- Identified bottlenecks and bugs, and devised solutions to these problems
- Wrote tests and conducted software testing to ensure satisfaction of application development requirements.
